note: Demo method based on IPCC default factors. NOT an official carbon standard. Every value below must be checked against the official IPCC document before the final submission; set verified to true only after checking.

carbon_fraction.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4 (AFOLU), Ch. 4, Table 4.3 (default carbon fraction of dry matter, 0.47)

tropical_dry_forest_asia.label: Tropical dry forest, Asia
tropical_dry_forest_asia.growth_source: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.9 (above-ground biomass growth, natural forest older than 20 years). CHECK VALUE.
tropical_dry_forest_asia.root_shoot_source: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.4 (tropical dry forest, above-ground biomass over 20 t/ha). CHECK VALUE.

tropical_moist_deciduous_asia.label: Tropical moist deciduous forest, Asia
tropical_moist_deciduous_asia.growth_source: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.9. CHECK VALUE.
tropical_moist_deciduous_asia.root_shoot_source: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.4. CHECK VALUE.
